messages:
tessa (billing): follow-up from yesterday's postmortem thread. late attribution caused underreported tokens across a handful of invoices. we need owners for: detection rule, ledger backfill, invoice adjustments vs credit notes, and customer comms.
cal (eng-infra): i'll take detection + alerting. plan: emit `ingest_ack_delay_ms` metric + rule -> #metering-alerts. will create MET-5120 on trigger. ETA: tomorrow AM.
marc (finance): i'll own credits and invoice adjustments. please provide final list with invoice_id, customer_id, token_delta, estimated_usd. target: complete < $500 credits in 2bd, > $500 review.
tessa (billing): quick extract (prelim):
```csv
invoice_id,customer_id,period,token_delta
inv_20260402_101,cust_201,2026-04-02T00:00Z-01:00Z,-640
inv_20260402_103,cust_411,2026-04-02T00:15Z-00:45Z,-190
```
rachel (eng-sre): root cause: delayed commit ack when ingest shard GC paused, causing attribution to fall into a later window. mitigation: add commit-timeout + idempotent commit path. PR in 36h, canary 48h after.
ida (customer-success): i'll prep comms templates: short credit notice and a reissue explanation. for enterprise customers i'll do AE-assisted outreach before reissue.
nina (legal): note: for some APAC customers we must reissue invoices instead of credit notes. include `requires_tax_review` in the CSV. i'll review reissue wording.
cal (eng-infra): detection rule sample: `ingest_ack_delay_ms > 60000 && estimated_token_delta <= -150` -> raise MET-5120, include sample trace_id and shard. will also create an automated JIRA ticket attached to the alert.
marc (finance): rounding policy proposal: round credits to nearest 50 tokens for <$2k/mo accounts; nearest 250 for >$2k/mo. reissue threshold $1,000 USD or tax-required regions.
tessa (billing): approved. i'll add to runbook. also adding `requires_approval` flag for contractually restricted accounts.
metering-bot: Ticket MET-5120 created: "ingest_ack_delay -> under-reported tokens" assigned to eng-infra.
rachel (eng-sre): additionally adding a nightly drift job to surface recurring customers (3+ incidents in 7d). ETA 5d.
marc (finance): workflow: 1) detection emits list -> 2) finance verifies token delta vs ledger -> 3a) if < $1k and no tax flags -> apply credit note within 2bd; 3b) if > $1k or tax flags -> prepare reissue + legal review within 5bd.
ida (customer-success): FAQ items i'll include: "how credits appear on invoice", "expected timing", "who to contact". will share drafts in 12h.
tessa (billing): action recap: cal -> detection + MET-5120 (tomorrow AM); rachel -> PR for commit-timeout & idempotency (PR 36h, canary 48h); marc -> credit/runbook + AR CSV (start after final list, credits < $1k in 2bd); ida -> comms + FAQ (12h); nina -> review reissue wording (24h). next checkpoint 48h or when MET-5120 moves to In Progress. :white_check_mark:
